title: Frequency Trick
subtitle: Test your grasp of the Frequency Trick — 3D Overlay sensory hijacking, solid-perception holography, parasite architecture, and revealing the Crystalline Temple.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Frequency Trick tunes projection frequencies so dead dense matter feels more real than living crystal, sustaining the 3D Overlay over the Known Lands. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Frequency Trick deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. Raise personal frequency, recognize the illusion, and the path is not build back—but reveal back the Crystalline Temple of free energy and instant travel.

questions.question: What is the 3D Overlay in this framework?

options.label: A
options.text: A permanent natural geology layer with no holographic projection and no link to the Known Lands.
options.rationale: The overlay is an artificial holographic construct over the Known Lands, not permanent natural geology alone.

options.label: B
options.text: A massive, multi-layered holographic illusion grid that blankets the true reality of the Known Lands.
options.rationale: The 3D Overlay is a massive, multi-layered holographic illusion grid that blankets the true reality of the Known Lands.

options.label: C
options.text: Only a single camera filter used by media with no effect on biological perception or density.
options.rationale: The overlay hijacks biological perception through a Frequency Trick tuned to 3D senses across the realm.

options.label: D
options.text: The true Crystalline Temple itself, composed only of living light without any false projection skin.
options.rationale: The Crystalline Temple is the true structure hidden beneath the 3D Overlay, not the overlay itself.

questions.hint: Connect the multi-layered holographic grid to the Known Lands.

options.text: A natural vision upgrade that automatically reveals living crystal without any parasitic projection field, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: The Frequency Trick is a parasitic field mechanism, not a natural upgrade that reveals crystal by default.

options.label: C
options.text: The mechanism that tunes projection frequencies to hijack human 3D senses so dead concrete and stone look and feel more real than living crystal.
options.rationale: The Frequency Trick tunes projection frequencies to hijack human 3D senses, making dead concrete and stone look and feel more real than living crystal.

options.label: D
options.text: A travel passport system that measures miles between cities without modulating light or sound signals, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: Distance is later revealed as an optical illusion of the overlay; the Frequency Trick is sensory hijacking of matter perception.

questions.hint: Focus on how projection frequencies hijack 3D senses regarding matter versus crystal.

options.label: B

options.rationale: By projecting a false skin over reality, the overlay filters, bends, and dampens the high-vibrational environment, trapping consciousness in simulated solidity, weight, and separation.

options.label: C
options.text: By permanently revealing living crystal so no one experiences solidity, weight, or separation at all, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: The overlay conceals living crystal and enforces simulated solidity rather than revealing true crystal by default.

options.label: D
options.text: By only affecting digital screens with no impact on biological eyes, skin, or nervous systems, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: The Frequency Trick hijacks biological 3D senses and modulates signals reaching the nervous system.

questions.hint: Name the false skin effect and the simulated qualities it enforces.
